result.reason: The addition reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. However, it also applies upon termination of any individual Service Option Attachment and requires return and deletion of all Content and Customer data. That could disrupt continuing Service Option Attachments, contrary to the original clause’s express preservation of those arrangements. The trigger should be limited to the affected attachment and its associated data, or to termination or expiry of the entire Agreement.
